Definition: from a derivative of G3415; to give a souvenir (engagement present), i.e. betroth:--espouse.
BiblicalUsage: Mnesteuo means to betroth — to be pledged in marriage. Mary is betrothed to Joseph when she is found with child of the Holy Spirit, and the angel Gabriel is sent to a virgin betrothed to a man named Joseph, of the house of David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the betrothal is where the whole story turns: God's promise arrives inside an ordinary engagement, and two ordinary people carry it.
RelatedEvents: The Annunciation to Mary; The Angel Appears to Joseph
